mutation CreateWorkOrder($workOrderPayload: [WorkOrderCreatePayloadInput!]!) {
  createWorkOrder(payload: $workOrderPayload) {
    id
    number
    priority
    quantity
    active
    buildToOrder
    buildToStock
    kanban
    customerReference
    description
    extProduct
    externalId
    orderReference
    actualFinishAt
    actualStartAt
    scheduledFinishAt
    scheduledStartAt
    dueAt
    earliestStartAt
    customData
    integrationData
    kanbanRackId
    productId
    productStrategyId
    workOrderStatusId
  }
}

mutation ($workOrderProcessPayload: [WorkOrderProcessCreatePayloadInput!]!, $workOrderProcessBomPayload: [WorkOrderProcessBomCreatePayloadInput!]!) {
  createWorkOrderProcess(payload: $workOrderProcessPayload) {
    id
    sequence
    standardPackQuantity
    unitWeight
    active
    description
    extWorkOrderProcess
    externalId
    note
    customData
    integrationData
    workOrderId
    defaultInventoryStatusId
    defaultPackagingMaterialId
    documentDesignId
    imageId
    processId
    putAwayLocationId
    
    
  }
  createWorkOrderProcessBom(payload: $workOrderProcessBomPayload) {
    id
    priority
    maximumUsage
    minimumUsage
    standardUsage
    active
    consumptionTypeId
    allowOverConsumption
    extProduct
    reference
    workOrderProcessId
    componentProductId
    componentProductStrategyId
    parentBomId
  }
}

data.query:
query WorkOrder(
  $where: WorkOrderWhereInput
  $orderBy: [WorkOrderOrderByInput!]
  $first: Int
  $after: String
) {
  workOrder(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        number
        priority
        quantity
        active
        buildToOrder
        buildToStock
        kanban
        customerReference
        description
        extProduct
        externalId
        orderReference
        actualFinishAt
        actualStartAt
        scheduledFinishAt
        scheduledStartAt
        dueAt
        earliestStartAt

        kanbanRackId
        productId
        productStrategyId
        workOrderStatusId
        workOrderProcesses {
          edges {
            node {
              id
              distribution
              sequence
              unitPerCycle
              productionOperators
              setupOperators
              standardPackQuantity
              unitWeight
              active
              description
              extWorkOrderProcess
              externalId
              name
              note

              cycleTime
              idealDuration
              processDuration
              setupDuration
              standardDuration
              transitAfter
              transitBefore
              workOrderId
              defaultInventoryStatusId
              defaultPackagingMaterialId
              documentDesignId
              imageId
              processId
              putAwayLocationId
              workunitId
              workOrderProcessDistributions {
                edges {
                  node {
                    id
                    dispatchSequence
                    unitPerCycle
                    balanceQuantity
                    producedQuantity
                    productionOperators
                    quantity
                    setupOperators
                    active
                    extWorkunit
                    group
                    name
                    actualFinishAt
                    actualStartAt
                    scheduledFinishAt
                    scheduledStartAt
                    cycleDuration
                    idealDuration
                    processDuration
                    scheduledDuration
                    setupDuration
                    standardDuration
                    transitAfter
                    transitBefore
                    distributionStatusId
                    kanbanCardId
                    leadingDistributionId
                    workOrderProcessId
                    workunitId
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
